description: Live USD price of any token by contract address ($0.001): Base by default, also ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon. From a simulated $100 buy and sale on the best on-chain route (Uniswap v2/v3/v4, Aerodrome): price, buy and sell price, round-trip cost (liquidity), total supply and fully diluted value. Use for the current USD price of one token by address; for a full swap quote of a size use get_swap_quote.

chain.description: Chain of the token or pool: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism or polygon (solana where listed). Not the payment network

name: get_token_price
